endonym.gloss: the standing talk, said both of the pipe and of what comes out of it

description.value: A stone-mounted wind pipe just over two metres long with three stops and a reed of cropped plate, set on the lee wall of the ring and voiced by the weather watch. It reproduces the prosody of the language with the vowels stripped out and is understood at four kilometres in weather that makes the mouth useless. It is not a musical instrument, is never sounded for pleasure, and the corporations regard the distinction as obvious. This one cracked along the mount in a blow in 2288 and was replaced the same week; it was given to the survey on the single condition that it not be sounded again.
